# ScriptDB documentation

> Lightweight synchronous and asynchronous SQLite wrapper for Python.

ScriptDB documentation:

- [Home](https://mihanentalpo.github.io/ScriptDB/): Overview, supported interfaces, and requirements.
- [Getting started](https://mihanentalpo.github.io/ScriptDB/getting-started/): Installation, lifecycle, options, and row factories.
- [Migrations](https://mihanentalpo.github.io/ScriptDB/migrations/): SQL, callable, and Builder migrations.
- [CRUD and queries](https://mihanentalpo.github.io/ScriptDB/queries/): Execution, inserts, updates, upserts, deletes, and query helpers.
- [Transactions and hooks](https://mihanentalpo.github.io/ScriptDB/transactions-hooks/): Transactions, periodic hooks, query-count hooks, and lifecycle guards.
- [Async API](https://mihanentalpo.github.io/ScriptDB/async/): Async operations, transactions, worker threads, and signal handling.
- [Cache API](https://mihanentalpo.github.io/ScriptDB/cache/): Persistent key-value cache, TTL, decorators, and RAM index.
- [SQL Builder](https://mihanentalpo.github.io/ScriptDB/builder/): CREATE, ALTER, DROP, indexes, and inferred schemas.
- [API reference](https://mihanentalpo.github.io/ScriptDB/api/): API reference overview.
- [API lifecycle](https://mihanentalpo.github.io/ScriptDB/api/lifecycle/): Opening, initialization, migrations, and transactions.
- [API CRUD](https://mihanentalpo.github.io/ScriptDB/api/crud/): SQL execution, inserts, updates, deletes, and upserts.
- [API queries](https://mihanentalpo.github.io/ScriptDB/api/queries/): Row fetching, streaming, scalar, column, and dictionary helpers.
- [API cache](https://mihanentalpo.github.io/ScriptDB/api/cache/): Cache methods and memoization decorator.
- [API hooks](https://mihanentalpo.github.io/ScriptDB/api/hooks/): Background hooks, conversion helpers, and backend diagnostics.
- [SQLite troubleshooting](https://mihanentalpo.github.io/ScriptDB/sqlite/): Backend selection and pysqlite diagnostics.
